form_analysis.feedback: Excellent aftercare form for vascular lasers targeting post-acne erythema. Provides clear guidance on managing purpura, preventing PIH, and the extended fading timeline. Strong emphasis on anti-inflammatory care and strict sun protection. Realistic expectations about residual redness and need for multiple sessions.

form_data.introduction: This aftercare is for vascular laser treatment (e.g., PDL/Vbeam, KTP) of persistent post-acne red marks (erythema). The laser targets dilated blood vessels causing the redness. Care focuses on minimizing inflammation, preventing darkening, and supporting vessel clearance.

instructions.general_directive: Follow for 7-14 days, with sun protection for 8+ weeks. The goal is to let the body absorb treated vessels without triggering new inflammation.

sections.title: Immediate Response & Purpura Timeline
items: Red marks will turn DARK PURPLE/GREY (purpura) - this is desired and indicates vessel damage.
Significant swelling around treated areas, especially if near eyes/cheeks.
Days 1-5: Intense purple bruising. Swelling peaks then subsides.
Days 5-14: Bruises fade through brown, green, yellow phases.
Weeks 2-8: Bruises clear, underlying redness gradually fades.

sections.title: Anti-Inflammatory Skincare (Critical)
items: Use products with NIACINAMIDE, CENTELLA ASIATICA, AZELAIC ACID to reduce redness.
AVOID: Vitamin C (L-ascorbic), retinoids, AHAs/BHAs for 2 weeks as they can increase inflammation.
Gentle cleansing only. No rubbing or massaging bruised areas.
Consider oral arnica or bromelain supplements to reduce bruising.

sections.title: Preventing Post-Inflammatory Hyperpigmentation (PIH)
sections.content: The #1 risk is purple bruises tanning into brown spots. SUN PROTECTION IS MANDATORY: Apply mineral (zinc oxide) SPF 50+ daily. Reapply every 2 hours if outdoors. Wear a hat. Avoid sun entirely for first 2 weeks.

sections.title: Activity Restrictions
items: Avoid exercise, heat, alcohol, spicy foods - anything that causes flushing for 7 days.

sections.title: Makeup for Coverage
sections.content: Green color corrector neutralizes purple/red tones. Apply over bruises after 48 hours. Use mineral makeup. Clean brushes.

sections.title: Results & Treatment Expectations
items: Stubborn erythema requires 2-4 sessions spaced 4-6 weeks apart.
Some background redness may always remain; goal is significant reduction, not perfection.
New acne breakouts will cause new red marks; continue acne control.
Follow-up at 6 weeks to assess fading and plan next treatment.

sections.title: Long-Term Redness Management
sections.content: Use daily redness-reducing skincare (niacinamide, azelaic acid). Strict lifelong sun protection. Manage active acne to prevent new marks. Consider annual maintenance treatments.

patient_declaration.reading_confirmation: Treating post-acne redness requires patience through the bruising phase and diligent sun protection.
patient_declaration.question_opportunity: Ask about the best color-correcting makeup for your specific bruising phase.
patient_declaration.declaration_text: I understand I will have significant bruising that must be protected from sun to prevent permanent dark spots.
